blend.lean: Slavic-heavy - the Wends/Veneti: a Slavic forest-and-swamp people with a Germanic warrior overlay

_note: Cross-family blend (Germanic + Slavic), leaning Slavic: the Wends - Slavic forest-and-swamp clans with a Germanic war-band overlay on the marches. Backbone = Slavic (phonology, the rod-clans, the knyaz ladder, the kapishche-grove); overlay = Germanic (gothic: a few war-titles and march-forts). clan = clanhold. Seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Slavic/Gothic registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Slavic primary, Germanic variant), never real gods.

phonology.palette: Slavic backbone (palatalization; sibilants sh/zh/ch/shch; dithematic glory-names -slav/-mir; -ov/-ich) with a Germanic overlay (-burg/-mark forts, a few dithematic war-names); theophoric on the Slavic morphs (Marakh-, Tulor-) with Germanic variants (Marahs-, Thulrs-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC and heavy clusters (str, zdr, vl, mn); the Germanic overlay adds -burg and dithematic compounds.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ov / -ev / -ich (son of); the rod (kin-clan); the Germanic-overlay war-bands keep a dithematic name; the Dedy (ancestral spirits) honored.
morphology.compounding_rule: dithematic glory-names (-slav glory, -mir peace/world); toponyms quality + feature: Chorn-boloto (black-swamp), Bel-gorod (white-town); the Germanic overlay yields -burg and -mark forts.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (Slavic rod-clans and the veche, with a Germanic war-band overlay on the marches: the knyaz and the voevoda, the markrad border-lords)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Slavic backbone, ascending, with a Germanic overlay at the march. Boyar (noble) barony; Markrad (Germanic march-lord, marca + -rad) march, over a Mark; Zhupan (district chief) county; Voevoda (war-leader) duchy; Knyaz (prince) principality; Velik Knyaz (grand prince) kingdom; Kagan (over-king) empire. The veche checks the knyaz; a clan culture rarely rises past the knyaz. (Rank titles are the real Slavic/Gothic register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal (dithematic -slav/-mir) + patronymic -ov/-ich; the rod (clan); the Germanic-overlay war-bands add a dithematic war-name.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the rod-clans keep Slavic glory-names; the march war-bands carry Germanic dithematic names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the morphed powers + a Slavic element: -slav (glory), Bog- (god), -dar (gift); the overlay adds Germanic -mers. e.g. Tuloslav, Bogudar, Marahs-mers.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Slavic primary, from family_slavic theonym_set; Germanic variant, from family_germanic reflexes), never real Slavic/Germanic gods. Venedan seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The volkhv keeps the kapishche-idol in the sacred grove; the Dedy (ancestral dead) are honored at the kurgan; the march war-bands keep a Germanic alhs-grove.
religion.the_one: Oterun (< Aeternus; Germanic variant Aiterns) - the distant Heaven-Father; reviled as the cold sky-tyrant when Chaotic, acknowledged when Neutral

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Marakh (Gmc Marahs) - the war-fire; Chaotic power
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numir (Gmc Numins) - the sky-thunder, the storm-word; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Goyan (Gmc Gauands) - the enduring earth; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Relata (Gmc Riala) - the mother, mercy; Neutral-honored

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Marakh, Vakid, Lusan), demonize the Lawful powers and the One (Oterun)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the Dedy (ancestral dead), the rod-spirits and the land-powers

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Lawful powers + the One, when Chaotic) take dread epithets: Tulrius -> Tulor the Soft-Sun; Orlandus -> Orlon the Oath-Chain; Aeternus -> Oterun the Sky-Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Kapishche (idol-shrine) of [power] in the grove, and the march Alhs (Germanic grove): 'the Kapishche of Numir', 'the Alhs of Marahs'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Dedy (ancestral dead) and rod-spirits at the kurgan; the war-bands honor their Germanic forebears (the Anses).

holy_symbol_motifs.Numir: an axe and thunder-mark above an oak
holy_symbol_motifs.Goyan: the black earth beneath the plough

banks_patterns.ships: river-trade ladya boats: 'the Grey Wolf', 'Swan of the Reka', 'the Far-rower'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [knyaz] Druzhina (war-band) / the march harjis (Germanic): 'the Wolf-Druzhina', 'the Boar-harjis'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned kapishcha, burned ostrogs and barrow-kurgans: 'the Kapishche of [name]', 'the Kurgan of [knyaz]'
